notes: INSIDE half of the Gauntling Arc Hammer: three steel capacitor cans with copper bands, exposed contacts between them that spit an arc on the loop, a patched hatch, power coupling and five copper coils that light cyan while charging (frame 5 = ready, green). fire: the coils flash white then go out. damaged: a can dented and arcing to the casing, two coils dead; disabled: a can split, the contacts burnt, wires hanging. Barrel layer gauntling_arc_hammer_barrel: a ram tube with copper windings ending in a battered hammer head with two ball electrodes and an arc between them; fire: the head slams forward and a blue-white flash.
